sponsored.t: Authorizes the town attorney of the town of Islip to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town attorney of the town of Islip, in the county of Suffolk, to be a nonresident of such town.

sponsored.t: Relates to the theft of a package intentionally taken from the residence of another following delivery by the postal service or a commercial carrier
sponsored.sum: Makes the theft of a package intentionally taken from a porch, driveway, doorway or other area adjacent to the residence of another following delivery of the package to such residence by the postal service or a commercial carrier a felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to divestiture of public funds in the Russian energy sector
sponsored.sum: Requires divestment of public funds in the Russian energy sector.

sponsored.t: Relates to unlawful operation of model or unmanned aircraft over a critical infrastructure facility
sponsored.sum: Provides that it is a class E felony to operate a model or unmanned aircraft over a critical infrastructure facility including an electrical power generating facility, petroleum or natural gas refinery or stage facility, or an aboveground oil, gas or chemical pipeline.

sponsored.t: Establishes the city of New York education fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the city of New York education fund from an additional real property tax to support education programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting "Todd's Law"
sponsored.sum: Relates to sentencing and larceny of property of the elderly or disabled.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of aggravated assault upon a police officer or a peace officer
sponsored.sum: Expands the crime of aggravated assault upon a police officer or a peace officer by removing the requirement that such injury be caused by a dangerous or deadly instrument.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 1020-dd of the public authorities law, relating to the prohibition of acceptance by the Long Island power authority of preference hydroelectricity
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to the prohibition of acceptance by the Long Island power authority of preference hydroelectricity.

sponsored.t: Establishes the police safety equipment grant program within the division of criminal justice services and makes an appropriation therefor
sponsored.sum: Creates a police safety equipment grant program to provide for services and expenses related to police safety equipment; directs a sum of $30,000,000 to be appropriated to such program.

sponsored.t: Requires schools and libraries to provide and maintain on-site opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts, public libraries, boards of cooperative educational services, county vocational education and extension boards, charter schools, and non-public elementary and secondary schools to provide and maintain on-site opioid antagonists.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulating the purchase and sale of catalytic converters
sponsored.sum: Regulates the purchase and sale of catalytic converters; permits only licensed or regulated scrap metal dealers, vehicle dealers, vehicle dismantlers or repair shops to possess, purchase or sell catalytic converters; makes unlawful possession an E felony; requires restitution.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program relating to creating the solar panels to school districts on Long Island pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program relating to creating the solar panels to the state universities of New York and boards of cooperative educational services located on Long Island in order that such universities and BOCES may conduct a training program for persons interested in learning solar panel installation and operation and then to install such solar panels upon school districts in Long Island.

sponsored.t: Relates to the liability of the state for damages to persons caused by defects in state highways
sponsored.sum: Imposes liability on the state for damages to persons caused by defects in state highways year round.

sponsored.t: Relates to the unlawful wearing of a body vest
sponsored.sum: Makes it unlawful to wear a body vest while committing any crime while possessing a deadly weapon.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of Melinda's Law in relation to the basis for removal of children
sponsored.sum: Protects a parent who is a victim of domestic violence from having children removed from their custody if they reported the abuse.

sponsored.t: Relates to the presumption of intent to sell heroin
sponsored.sum: Creates the presumption of intent to sell when a person is in possession of forty or more individual packages containing heroin with an aggregate weight of 4.0 grams.

sponsored.t: Establishes the offense of obstructing a police officer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the offense of obstructing a police officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to assault on a member of an auxiliary police program
sponsored.sum: Includes injury to an on-duty auxiliary police officer within the elements of assault in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Authorizes NYS power authority to allow certain governments and corporations to bundle electrical services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the NYS power authority to allow certain governments and corporations to bundle electrical services.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the Gold Award and Eagle Scout achievement scholarship
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the Gold Award and Eagle Scout achievement scholarship; authorizes a scholarship of $500 per year for high school graduates attending a New York state public post-secondary institution who have achieved a Gold Award from the Girl Scouts of the United States of America or an Eagle Scout from the Boy Scouts of America.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a death
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a death.

sponsored.t: Relates to the improvement and operation of sober living homes
sponsored.sum: Relates to the improvement and operation of sober living homes including the process for certification, inspections, and violations and the establishment of a toll free hotline to respond to complaints.

sponsored.t: Creates the under-grounding of electrical power or telecommunications lines fund
sponsored.sum: Creates the under-grounding of electrical power or telecommunications lines fund to provide for the purpose of moving overhead electrical power or telecommunications lines underground from monies appropriated, including, but not limited to, any funds supplied by the Federal Emergency Management Agency for disaster recovery and hazard mitigation which may be used for state infrastructure repair.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of criminal history background checks free of charge to mentoring programs operated by not-for-profit corporations
sponsored.sum: Provides for free criminal history background checks for mentoring programs operated by not-for-profit corporations.

sponsored.t: Relates to fixing a maximum interest rate for credit cards issued or used in this state
sponsored.sum: Fixes the maximum interest rate for credit cards issued or used in this state at 10%.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to 9-11 Fallen Firefighters
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the Long Island Expressway in the town of Brookhaven to 9-11 Fallen Firefighters.
